visualCharacteristics.purpose: two-column layout where the last text column is a tinted callout panel (optional heading, intro, check list, divider, footnote); the other column holds text or an image

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: cell 1 = text or image (with-image), cell 2 = callout panel content (heading, paragraph, bullet list rendered as check list, optional horizontal rule and footnote)

usage: Highlight a short checklist next to body text or a photo. Use `with-image` when the left cell is a photo.
reuseGuidance: Use for any panelled checklist beside content; plain side-by-side content uses columns.
